# Native Moco Physical-Body Preflight

Issue #12205 connects the source-body audit in chapter52 to the maintained
OpenSim Moco preparation and solve boundary. Preparation independently audits
the exact source XML and a fresh native OpenSim model, writes the complete
physical-body audit to a SHA-256-bound sidecar, and retains all other obtainable
capture, guess, registration, passive-force and actuation blockers. A rejected
or unavailable body audit is a distinct preparation blocker. Read-only model
diagnostics remain possible; no physically unqualified source enters Moco
optimization through this runner.

Before solve, the runner requires a present, admitted audit sidecar matching
the prepared digest. It reconstructs a fresh native model and repeats the
chapter52 source/native mass, body-frame COM, six inertia-component and
principal-moment audit. The new audit must match the frozen sidecar exactly,
including the source, adapter, shared validator and native runtime identities.
An old preparation without this evidence fails closed. Changing a sidecar,
validator implementation or model bytes after preparation cannot authorize a
solve. The same input-revalidation boundary protects later export and replay.

The native test uses both Millard and Thelen muscle fixtures. A valid source
binds an admitted audit. A rotated positive-definite tensor with invalid
principal-moment triangle is rejected before solve; a malformed massless
body retains its own physical blocker alongside independent preparation
blockers. This necessary physical gate does not certify anatomy, passive
physiology, contact/grip, captured-marker correspondence, a full swing, or
muscle-only control. The unchanged 557-muscle source still fails for four
positive-mass bodies. All 17 required variants across six ecosystems remain
in the acceptance denominator, and publication remains blocked.
